definition: to turn on the engine of a car
exampleSentence: He started the car and drove off.
exampleTranslation: Bạn ấy nổ máy xe rồi chạy đi.

definition: to stop the engine of a car
exampleSentence: Turn off the engine when you stop.
exampleTranslation: Hãy tắt máy khi dừng xe.

definition: to move the mirror so you can see behind
exampleSentence: Adjust the mirror before you drive.
exampleTranslation: Hãy chỉnh gương trước khi lái xe.

definition: to look in the car mirror before you move
exampleSentence: Check the mirror before you turn.
exampleTranslation: Nhìn gương trước khi rẽ.

definition: to show with a signal that you are going to turn
exampleSentence: Always indicate before you turn.
exampleTranslation: Luôn bật xi-nhan trước khi rẽ.

definition: to go towards the right
exampleSentence: Turn right after the bank.
exampleTranslation: Rẽ phải sau ngân hàng.

definition: to move the gear stick to another position
exampleSentence: Change gear before the hill.
exampleTranslation: Hãy chuyển số trước khi lên dốc.

definition: to push the pedal that makes a car slow down
exampleSentence: He pressed the brake quickly.
exampleTranslation: Bạn ấy đạp phanh thật nhanh.

definition: to stop a car very quickly
exampleSentence: I had to brake hard to avoid the dog.
exampleTranslation: Tôi phải phanh gấp để tránh con chó.

definition: to go faster
exampleSentence: The car speeded up on the open road.
exampleTranslation: Chiếc xe tăng tốc trên đoạn đường thoáng.

definition: to stop when the traffic light is red
exampleSentence: Always stop at the red light.
exampleTranslation: Luôn dừng lại ở đèn đỏ.

definition: to pass a car that is going slower
exampleSentence: It is dangerous to overtake a car on a bend.
exampleTranslation: Vượt xe ở khúc cua rất nguy hiểm.

definition: to drive the car backwards
exampleSentence: Reverse the car slowly into the space.
exampleTranslation: Lùi xe từ từ vào chỗ đỗ.

definition: to find an empty place to park
exampleSentence: It is hard to find a parking space downtown.
exampleTranslation: Ở trung tâm rất khó tìm chỗ đỗ xe.

definition: to give money so you can leave your car in a place
exampleSentence: We pay for parking by the hour.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi trả tiền gửi xe theo giờ.

definition: to put petrol in the car until the tank is full
exampleSentence: I need to fill up the tank before the trip.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cần đổ đầy bình xăng trước chuyến đi.

definition: to see how much oil is in the car engine
exampleSentence: Check the oil once a month.
exampleTranslation: Hãy kiểm tra dầu máy mỗi tháng một lần.

definition: to see if the tyres have enough air
exampleSentence: Check the tyres before a long trip.
exampleTranslation: Hãy kiểm tra lốp xe trước một chuyến đi dài.

definition: to put more air into the tyres
exampleSentence: I pump up the tyres at the petrol station.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bơm lốp xe ở trạm xăng.

definition: to have a tyre with no air in it
exampleSentence: We got a flat tyre on the highway.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi bị xẹp lốp trên đường cao tốc.

definition: to ask a car repair person to come
exampleSentence: We called a mechanic to fix the engine.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi gọi thợ sửa xe đến sửa động cơ.

definition: to have the car checked and repaired by a garage
exampleSentence: I get the car serviced every year.
exampleTranslation: Năm nào tôi cũng đem xe đi bảo dưỡng.

definition: to get a new date on your driving licence
exampleSentence: I need to renew my licence this year.
exampleTranslation: Năm nay tôi cần gia hạn bằng lái.

definition: to succeed in the test to get a driving licence
translation: đậu kỳ thi lấy bằng lái
exampleSentence: She passed her driving test at the first try.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy đậu kỳ thi lấy bằng lái ngay lần đầu.

definition: to take someone somewhere in your car
exampleSentence: Can you give me a lift to the station?
exampleTranslation: Bạn cho tôi đi nhờ xe đến nhà ga được không?

definition: to take someone somewhere and let them get out
translation: thả ai xuống, đưa ai đến nơi
exampleSentence: I drop my kids off at school.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đưa các con đến trường.

definition: to collect someone in your car
exampleSentence: I will pick you up at eight.
exampleTranslation: Tám giờ tôi sẽ đến đón bạn.

definition: to lock the doors of a car
exampleSentence: Don't forget to lock the car.
exampleTranslation: Đừng quên khóa xe.

definition: to open the back part of a car where you put bags
exampleSentence: Open the boot and put the bags in.
exampleTranslation: Mở cốp xe rồi cho túi vào.
